bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · lost the 100-day average
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 失守 100 日均线

read.en: TSMC fell 1.8% on Oct 15 to $422.25 on heavy volume and is down 8% in five sessions. It closed below the rising 100-day average ($430.1) and its 5-day ($439.0), 10-day ($456.6) and 30-day ($444.4) averages, and is above the 200-day ($394.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and is still above zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($474.1), and RSI is 38.
read.zh: 台积电 10月15日放量下跌 1.8%，收于 $422.25，五个交易日下跌 8%。股价收于上行的 100 日均线（$430.1）以及 5 日（$439.0）、10 日（$456.6）和 30 日均线（$444.4）下方，并在 200 日均线（$394.5）上方。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$474.1），RSI 为 38。

read.en: The $429–430 support (100-day average, Aug 27 high) broke on the close and is now first resistance, then $439–444 (5 and 30-day averages) and $456.6 (10-day). The day's low of $407.15 tested the $405–408 Aug 24 and Sep 3 lows. Support is $412.5 (Sep 15 low), then $405–408 and $394.5 (200-day average). A close below $405 would open $394.5.

s.en: Aug 24 and Sep 3 lows ($405–408); Oct 15 low $407.2
